children: Vertiseit’s unit Visual Art signed a global framework agreement with Circle K for Digital In-store solutions, valid until Oct 31, 2028. No volume guarantees; potential expansion from ~2,500 to ~14,000 stations.
Multi-year visibility; underpins pipeline and supports recurring SaaS growth.
Direct fit to core IXM offering; potential ARR expansion if rolled out.
Upside optionality but limited near-term revenue certainty.
Scales from current ~2,500; large TAM if adopted globally.
Track record reduces execution risk for broader rollout.

This extends a long-running Circle K relationship and signals Vertiseit’s push from regional to global scale in IXM. For a bigger catalyst, investors need concrete rollout orders, station counts added, and ARR/revenue contributions tied to this framework.
